articles.title_en: Dynamic Privacy Choices
articles.title_cn: 动态隐私选择
articles.abstract_en: I study a dynamic model of consumer privacy and platform data collection. In each period consumers choose their level of platform activity. Greater activity generates more information about the consumer, thereby increasing platform profits. When the platform can commit to the future privacy policy, it collects information by committing to gradually decreasing the level of privacy protection. In the long run consumers lose privacy and receive low payoffs but choose high activity levels. In contrast, the platform with weaker commitment power may attain the commitment outcome or fail to collect any data depending on consumer expectations regarding future privacy protection. (JEL C93, D11, D82, D83, D84, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个关于消费者隐私和平台数据收集的动态模型。在每个时期，消费者选择他们的平台活动水平。更多的活动会产生关于消费者的更多信息，从而增加平台利润。当平台能够承诺未来的隐私政策时，它通过承诺逐渐降低隐私保护水平来收集信息。从长远来看，消费者失去隐私并获得低回报，但选择高活动水平。相比之下，承诺能力较弱的平台可能根据消费者对未来隐私保护的预期，达到承诺结果或无法收集任何数据。(JEL C93, D11, D82, D83, D84, L86)

articles.title_en: Blind Disclosure
articles.title_cn: 盲目披露
articles.abstract_en: We develop and test a theory of blind disclosure. A sender chooses whether to disclose information based on a preliminary, private signal. In the unique equilibrium, contrary to the literature’s canonical unraveling result, senders disclose only if their preliminary signal exceeds a cutoff. This cutoff rule leads to partial unraveling in environments with either risk aversion or moral hazard, and disclosure decreases with uncertainty. Using unique administrative data on disclosed and undisclosed grades in a large university, we find that the model is consistent with student choices during spring 2020 to conceal letter grades by switching to optional pass-fail grades. (JEL D81, D82, I23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并检验了一个盲目披露理论。发送者根据初步的私人信号选择是否披露信息。在唯一均衡中，与文献中的经典揭示结果相反，发送者仅在其初步信号超过某个临界值时才会披露。这一临界值规则在存在风险厌恶或道德风险的环境中导致部分揭示，且披露随不确定性增加而减少。利用某大型大学中已披露和未披露成绩的独特行政数据，我们发现该模型与学生在2020年春季通过转换为可选及格-不及格成绩来隐藏字母等级的选择一致。（JEL D81, D82, I23）

articles.title_en: Optimal Nonlinear Pricing with Data-Sensitive Consumers
articles.title_cn: 数据敏感型消费者的最优非线性定价
articles.abstract_en: We study monopolistic screening when some consumers are data sensitive and incur a privacy cost if their purchase reveals information to the monopolist. The monopolist discriminates between data-sensitive and classical consumers using privacy mechanisms that consist of a direct mechanism and a privacy option. A privacy mechanism is optimal for large privacy costs and leaves classical consumers better off than data-sensitive consumers with the same valuation. When privacy preferences become public information, data-sensitive consumers and the monopolist gain, whereas classical consumers lose. Our results are relevant for policies targeting consumers’ data awareness, such as the European General Data Protection Regulation. (JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当部分消费者具有数据敏感性，且其购买行为向垄断者披露信息会带来隐私成本时的垄断者甄别问题。垄断者通过由直接机制和隐私选项组成的隐私机制来区分数据敏感型消费者和传统消费者。对于较大的隐私成本，隐私机制是最优的，并且使得具有相同估值的传统消费者比数据敏感型消费者获得更高的效用。当隐私偏好成为公开信息时，数据敏感型消费者和垄断者获益，而传统消费者受损。我们的研究结果对针对消费者数据意识的政策具有相关性，例如欧洲通用数据保护条例。（JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12）

articles.title_en: Competition in Pricing Algorithms
articles.title_cn: 定价算法中的竞争
articles.abstract_en: We document new facts about pricing technology using high-frequency data, and we examine the implications for competition. Some online retailers employ technology that allows for more frequent price changes and automated responses to price changes by rivals. Motivated by these facts, we consider a model in which firms can differ in pricing frequency and choose pricing algorithms that are a function of rivals’ prices. In competitive (Markov perfect) equilibrium, the introduction of simple pricing algorithms can increase price levels, generate price dispersion, and exacerbate the price effects of mergers. (JEL D21, D22, D43, G34, L13, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用高频数据记录了关于定价技术的新事实，并考察了其对竞争的影响。一些在线零售商采用的技术允许更频繁的价格变动以及对竞争对手价格变动的自动响应。受这些事实的启发，我们考虑了一个模型，其中企业可以在定价频率上有所不同，并选择作为竞争对手价格函数的定价算法。在竞争性（马尔可夫完美）均衡中，简单定价算法的引入可以提高价格水平，产生价格离散，并加剧合并的价格效应。（JEL D21, D22, D43, G34, L13, L81）

articles.title_en: Targeted Product Design
articles.title_cn: 目标产品设计
articles.abstract_en: We propose an intuitive representation of product design in which firms locate inside a circle and consumers in its outer circumference. Designs trade off horizontal and vertical transport costs. Our setting encompasses all linear demand rotations. Firms with lower quality or higher marginal costs choose niche designs that cater to specific consumers at the expense of alienating the rest. Firms choose intermediate designs or more polarized ones, instead, depending on the convexity of the vertical transport cost. We examine such design choices in monopoly, duopoly, and monopolistic competition settings. (JEL D21, D24, D42, D43)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种直观的产品设计表示，其中企业位于圆内，消费者位于圆周上。设计在水平与垂直运输成本之间进行权衡。我们的设定涵盖了所有线性需求旋转。质量较低或边际成本较高的企业选择利基设计，以迎合特定消费者，但代价是疏远其他消费者。相反，企业选择中间设计或更两极化的设计，这取决于垂直运输成本的凸性。我们考察了垄断、双头垄断和垄断竞争环境中的此类设计选择。（JEL D21, D24, D42, D43）

articles.title_en: The Good, the Bad, and the Complex: Product Design with Imperfect Information
articles.title_cn: 好、坏与复杂：不完全信息下的产品设计
articles.abstract_en: We study the joint determination of product quality and complexity. In our model complexity affects how difficult it is for an agent to acquire information about product quality. An agent can accept or reject a product proposed by a designer, who can affect the quality and the complexity of the product. We find that complexity is not a necessary feature of low-quality products. An increase in designer–agent alignment leads to more complex but better-quality products. However, higher product demand or lower competition among designers leads to more complex and lower-quality products. We relate our findings to the existing empirical evidence. (JEL D82, D83, G23, L15, L51, L84)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了产品质量与复杂性的联合决定。在我们的模型中，复杂性影响代理人获取产品质量信息的难度。代理人可以接受或拒绝设计师提出的产品，而设计师可以影响产品的质量和复杂性。我们发现，复杂性并非低质量产品的必要特征。设计师与代理人之间一致性的增加会导致产品更复杂但质量更高。然而，更高的产品需求或设计师之间更低的竞争会导致产品更复杂且质量更低。我们将我们的发现与现有的经验证据联系起来。（JEL D82, D83, G23, L15, L51, L84）

articles.title_en: Ad Clutter, Time Use, and Media Diversity
articles.title_cn: 广告拥挤、时间使用与媒体多样性
articles.abstract_en: We introduce advertising congestion along with a time use model of consumer choice among media. Both consumers and advertisers multihome. Higher equilibrium advertising levels ensue on less popular media platforms because platforms treat consumer attention as a common property resource: smaller platforms internalize less of the congestion from advertising and so advertise more. Platform entry raises the ad nuisance price to consumers and diminishes the quality of the consumption experience on all platforms. For consumer welfare this price effect of entry dominates the positive effect of more variety in some settings; thus, consumers will then be worse off after entry. (JEL D11, D43, L13, L82, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入广告拥挤以及消费者在媒体间选择的时间使用模型。消费者和广告商都进行多归属。均衡广告水平在较不流行的媒体平台上更高，因为平台将消费者注意力视为公共财产资源：较小的平台较少内化广告带来的拥挤，因此广告更多。平台进入提高了消费者的广告滋扰价格，并降低了所有平台上消费体验的质量。对于消费者福利而言，在某些情况下，这种进入的价格效应超过了更多多样性的积极效应；因此，进入后消费者的境况可能会变差。（JEL D11, D43, L13, L82, M37）

articles.title_en: Reference Dependence and Attribution Bias: Evidence from Real-Effort Experiments
articles.title_cn: 参考依赖与归因偏差：来自真实努力实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We document a form of attribution bias wherein people wrongly ascribe sensations of positive or negative surprise to the underlying disutility of a real-effort task. Participants in our experiments learned from experience about two unfamiliar tasks, one more onerous than the other. We manipulated expectations about which task they would face: some participants were assigned their task by chance, while others knew their assignment in advance. Hours later, we elicited willingness to work again on that same task. Participants assigned the less (more) onerous task by chance were more (less) willing to work than those who knew their assignment in advance. (JEL C91, D84, D91, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一种归因偏差形式，即人们错误地将积极或消极惊喜的感受归因于真实努力任务的基本负效用。在我们的实验中，参与者通过经验了解了两个不熟悉的任务，其中一个比另一个更繁重。我们操纵了他们对将要面对哪个任务的预期：一些参与者通过随机方式被分配任务，而另一些则提前知道他们的分配。数小时后，我们引出了他们再次从事同一任务的意愿。通过随机方式被分配到较不（更）繁重任务的参与者比那些提前知道分配的人更（不）愿意工作。（JEL C91, D84, D91, M54）

articles.title_en: The Doors of Perception: Theory and Evidence of Frame-Dependent Rationalizability
articles.title_cn: 知觉之门：框架依赖理性化的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how strategic behavior is affected by the set of notions (frames) used when thinking about the game. In our games the action set consists of visual objects: each player must privately choose one, trying to match the counterpart’s choice. We propose a model where different player-types are aware of different attributes of the action set (hence, different frames). One of the novelties is an epistemic structure that allows players to think about new frames, after initial unawareness of some attributes. To test the model, our experimental design brings about multiple frames by varying subjects’ awareness of several attributes. (JEL C72, C78, C91, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在思考博弈时所使用的概念集（框架）如何影响策略行为。在我们的博弈中，行动集由视觉对象组成：每个参与者必须私下选择一个，试图与对手的选择相匹配。我们提出了一个模型，其中不同的参与者类型意识到行动集的不同属性（因此，有不同的框架）。新颖之处之一是一种认知结构，允许参与者在最初对某些属性无意识之后，思考新的框架。为了检验该模型，我们的实验设计通过改变参与者对几个属性的意识来产生多个框架。（JEL C72, C78, C91, D83）

articles.title_en: Reference Pricing as a Deterrent to Entry: Evidence from the European Pharmaceutical Market
articles.title_cn: 参考定价作为进入威慑：来自欧洲药品市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: External reference pricing (ERP), the practice of benchmarking domestic drug prices to foreign prices, generates an incentive for firms to withhold products from low-income countries. Using a novel moment inequality approach, we estimate a structural model to measure how ERP policies affect access to innovative drugs across Europe. We find that ERP increases entry delays in eight low-income European countries by up to one year per drug. The European Union could remove these delays without replacing ERP by compensating firms through lump-sum transfers at the cost of around €18 million per drug. (JEL L13, L51, L65)
articles.abstract_cn: 外部参考定价（ERP），即根据国外价格设定国内药品价格的基准做法，会产生企业向低收入国家扣留产品的激励。我们使用一种新颖的矩不等式方法，估计了一个结构模型，以衡量ERP政策如何影响欧洲创新药物的可及性。我们发现，ERP使八个低收入欧洲国家的药品进入延迟每药最多增加一年。欧盟可以通过一次性转移支付补偿企业，以每药约18百万欧元的成本消除这些延迟，而无需替换ERP。（JEL L13, L51, L65）

articles.title_en: Complexity and Procedural Choice
articles.title_cn: 复杂性与程序选择
articles.abstract_en: We test the core ideas of the “automata” approach to bounded rationality, using simple experimental bandit tasks. Optimality requires subjects to use a moderately complex decision procedure, but most subjects in our baseline condition instead use simpler (often suboptimal) procedures that economize on “states” in the algorithmic structure of the rule. When we artificially remove the mental costs of tracking states by having the computer track and organize past events, subjects abandon these simpler rules and use maximally complex optimal rules instead. The results thus suggest that the main type of complexity described in the automata literature fundamentally influences behavior. (JEL C91, D12, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用简单的实验性老虎机任务，检验了“自动机”方法对有限理性的核心思想。最优性要求受试者使用中等复杂度的决策程序，但我们在基线条件下的多数受试者反而使用更简单（通常次优）的程序，这些程序在规则的算法结构中节省了“状态”。当我们通过让计算机跟踪和组织过去的事件来人为地消除跟踪状态的心理成本时，受试者放弃了这些更简单的规则，转而使用最大复杂度的最优规则。因此，结果表明，自动机文献中描述的主要复杂性类型从根本上影响了行为。（JEL C91, D12, D91）

articles.title_en: Biased Beliefs in Search Markets
articles.title_cn: 搜索市场中的有偏信念
articles.abstract_en: We study the implications of biased consumer beliefs for search market outcomes in the seminal framework due to Diamond (1971). Biased consumers base their search strategy on a belief function that specifies for any (true) distribution of utility offers in the market a possibly incorrect distribution of utility offers. If biased consumers overestimate the best offer in the market, a novel type of equilibrium may emerge in which firms make exceptionally favorable offers in order to meet biased consumers’ unreasonably high expectations, which then become partially self-fulfilling. Consequently, the presence of biased consumers may improve the welfare of all consumers. (JEL D11, D21, D83, D84)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在Diamond（1971）的开创性框架中研究消费者有偏信念对搜索市场结果的影响。有偏消费者基于一个信念函数来制定其搜索策略，该信念函数针对市场中效用报价的任何（真实）分布，指定一个可能不正确的效用报价分布。如果有偏消费者高估了市场中的最优报价，可能会出现一种新型均衡，在这种均衡中，企业提供异常优惠的报价以满足有偏消费者不切实际的高期望，这些期望随后部分地自我实现。因此，有偏消费者的存在可能改善所有消费者的福利。（JEL D11, D21, D83, D84）

articles.title_en: At the Helm, Kirk or Spock? The Pros and Cons of Charismatic Leadership
articles.title_cn: 掌舵者，柯克还是斯波克？魅力型领导的利与弊
articles.abstract_en: Charismatic leaders are often desired. At the same time, experience, especially with demagogues, as well as social science studies, raise doubts about such leaders. This paper offers explanations for charismatic leadership’s “mixed report card.” It offers insights into why and when charismatic leadership can be effective; which, when, and why certain groups will prefer more to less charismatic leaders; and how being more charismatic can make leaders worse in other dimensions, particularly causing them to work less hard on their followers’ behalf. (JEL D72, D83, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 魅力型领导往往备受追捧。与此同时，经验（尤其是与煽动家打交道的经验）以及社会科学研究，却对这种领导提出质疑。本文为魅力型领导的“好坏参半的成绩单”提供了解释。文中探讨了魅力型领导为何以及何时能够有效；哪些群体、在何种情况下以及为何会偏好魅力程度更高而非更低的领导；以及更具魅力如何可能使领导在其他方面表现更差，尤其是导致他们不再那么努力地为追随者谋福利。（JEL D72, D83, M54）

articles.title_en: Too Good to Be True? Retention Rules for Noisy Agents
articles.title_cn: 好得令人难以置信？对噪声代理人的留任规则
articles.abstract_en: An agent who privately knows his type seeks to be retained by a principal. Agents signal their type with some ambient noise, but can alter this noise, perhaps at some cost. Our main finding is that in equilibrium, the principal treats extreme signals in either direction with suspicion, and retains the agent if and only if the signal falls in some intermediate bounded set. In short, she follows the maxim: “if it seems too good to be true, it probably is.” We consider extensions and applications, including non-normal signal structures, dynamics with term limits, risky portfolio management, and political risk-taking. (JEL D72, D82, G11, G41)
articles.abstract_cn: 一个私下知晓自己类型的代理人寻求被委托人留任。代理人通过一些环境噪声来传递其类型信号，但可以改变这种噪声，或许需要付出一定成本。我们的主要发现是，在均衡中，委托人对任一方向的极端信号持怀疑态度，并且仅当信号落在某个中间有界集合内时才留任代理人。简言之，她遵循这样的准则：“如果某事好得令人难以置信，那它很可能就是假的。”我们考虑了扩展和应用，包括非正态信号结构、有任期限制的动态、风险投资组合管理以及政治风险承担。（JEL D72, D82, G11, G41）

articles.title_en: Learning by Choosing: Career Concerns with Observable Actions
articles.title_cn: 选择中学习：可观察行动下的职业关注
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores potential inefficiencies of incomplete contracts in a dynamic career concerns context. In a firm-worker relationship, the worker performs public tasks that have trade-offs between productivity and informativeness. We show that the first-best outcome can be obtained with short-term contracts if the wage can depend on the task choice. This provides an explanation for wage jumps at promotions—the worker is assigned the more productive but less informative task after promotion. If task choice is not contractible, then inefficiency arises: the worker has an endogenous bias toward informativeness, while the firm is biased toward productivity. (JEL D82, D83, D86, J24, J31, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了动态职业关注背景下不完全契约的潜在低效率。在企业与工人的关系中，工人执行公共任务，这些任务在生产率和信息量之间存在权衡。我们表明，如果工资可以依赖于任务选择，那么短期契约可以实现最优结果。这为晋升时的工资跃升提供了一种解释——晋升后，工人被分配到生产率更高但信息量更少的任务。如果任务选择不可契约化，则会出现低效率：工人对信息量存在内生偏好，而企业则偏向于生产率。（JEL D82, D83, D86, J24, J31, M51）

articles.title_en: Relative Wealth Concerns, Executive Compensation, and Managerial Risk-Taking
articles.title_cn: 相对财富关注、高管薪酬与管理层风险承担
articles.abstract_en: This paper theoretically examines how relative wealth concerns affect equilibrium contracting and systemic risk-taking. We find that such externalities can generate pay for luck as an equilibrium strategy. In expectation of pay for luck in other firms, tying managerial pay to luck provides insurance to managers against a compensation shortfall relative to executive peers. We also show that an effort-inducing mechanism exists: managers have additional incentives to exert effort in utilizing investment opportunities, which helps them keep up with their peers during industry movements; however, pay for luck that is efficient within firms can nonetheless exacerbate aggregate fluctuations, especially during periods of heightened market risk. (JEL D81, D82, D86, G51, M12, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文从理论上考察了相对财富关注如何影响均衡契约和系统性风险承担。我们发现，这种外部性可以产生为运气付费作为均衡策略。预期到其他公司存在为运气付费，将管理层薪酬与运气挂钩为管理者提供了相对于同行高管薪酬缺口的保险。我们还表明，存在一种努力激励机制：管理者在利用投资机会方面有额外的努力激励，这有助于他们在行业变动中跟上同行；然而，公司内部有效的为运气付费却可能加剧总体波动，尤其是在市场风险加剧时期。（JEL D81, D82, D86, G51, M12, M52）

articles.title_en: Raising the Bar: Certification Thresholds and Market Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 提高门槛：认证阈值与市场结果
articles.abstract_en: Certification of sellers by trusted third parties helps alleviate information asymmetries in markets, yet little is known about the impact of a certification’s threshold on market outcomes. Exploiting a policy change on eBay, we study how a more selective certification threshold affects the distribution of quality and incumbent behavior. We develop a stylized model that shows how changes in selectivity change the distribution of quality and prices in markets. Using rich data from hundreds of online categories on eBay.com , we find support for the model’s hypotheses. Our results help inform the design of certification selectivity in electronic and other markets. (JEL D82, L11, L15, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 由可信第三方对卖家进行认证有助于缓解市场中的信息不对称，然而关于认证阈值对市场结果的影响却知之甚少。利用eBay上的一项政策变化，我们研究了更具选择性的认证阈值如何影响质量分布和现有卖家行为。我们构建了一个简化模型，展示了选择性变化如何改变市场中的质量分布和价格。利用来自eBay.com上数百个在线类别的丰富数据，我们找到了支持模型假设的证据。我们的结果有助于为电子市场及其他市场的认证选择性设计提供信息。(JEL D82, L11, L15, L86)

articles.title_en: Stable and Efficient Resource Allocation with Contracts
articles.title_cn: 契约下的稳定与高效资源分配
articles.abstract_en: Consider indivisible-object allocation with contracts, such as college admissions, where contracts specify majors. Can a designer guarantee a stable and (student) efficient matching? I show that contracts put stability and efficiency at odds; a necessary condition to ensure these properties is student-lexicographic priorities—schools must rank contracts from “second-tier” students consecutively. I present the weakest restriction guaranteeing stability and efficiency, and characterize necessary and sufficient conditions for any mechanism within a general class to deliver a stable and efficient matching in an incentive compatible manner. I apply this result to two well-known mechanisms: deferred acceptance and top trading cycles. (JEL C78, D82, D86, I23)
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑不可分割物品与契约的分配问题，例如大学录取，其中契约指定专业。设计者能否保证稳定且（学生）高效的匹配？我表明契约使稳定性与效率相互冲突；确保这些性质的必要条件是学生字典序优先级——学校必须将来自“二流”学生的契约连续排序。我提出了保证稳定性与效率的最弱限制，并刻画了一般类机制中任何机制以激励相容方式提供稳定且高效匹配的充分必要条件。我将此结果应用于两个著名机制：延迟接受和顶层交易循环。（JEL C78, D82, D86, I23）

articles.title_en: Optimal Task Scheduling under Adverse Selection and Hidden Actions
articles.title_cn: 逆向选择与隐藏行动下的最优任务调度
articles.abstract_en: A Principal owns a project consisting of several tasks. Tasks differ, both in their innate success probabilities and their incremental benefits. Moreover, only specialists can perform these tasks. Subject to moral hazard and adverse selection, in what order should the Principal commission the tasks, and when should she terminate the project? What investments into changing tasks’ characteristics yield the highest marginal profit? These are typical issues that arise in sequencing R&D activities and other sequential production processes. We show that, despite informational constraints, a simple index—a task’s effective marginal contribution—determines the optimal schedule/mechanism. (JEL D82, L23, L24, L65, M11, O31)
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人拥有一个由若干任务组成的项目。任务在固有成功概率和增量收益方面各不相同。此外，只有专家才能执行这些任务。在道德风险和逆向选择的约束下，委托人应按照什么顺序委托任务，以及何时终止项目？对改变任务特征的投资中，哪些能产生最高的边际利润？这些是排序研发活动和其他顺序生产过程中出现的典型问题。我们表明，尽管存在信息约束，一个简单的指标——任务的有效边际贡献——决定了最优调度/机制。（JEL D82, L23, L24, L65, M11, O31）

articles.title_en: Markets with Within-Type Adverse Selection
articles.title_cn: 具有类型内逆向选择的市场
articles.abstract_en: We study bilateral trade with a seller owning multiple units of a good, where each unit is of binary quality. The seller privately knows her “type”—defined by the number of lemons that she owns—and which units in her endowments are the lemons (“ within-type adverse selection”). We characterize the set of informationally constrained Pareto optimal allocations and show that every such allocation must involve a trade characterized by a threshold λ ∗ , with types having less (more) than λ ∗ units of lemons selling only their lemons (selling their entire endowment). We provide conditions for a distribution shift that give Pareto-improving allocations. (JEL D82, D86, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个卖方拥有多单位商品的双边贸易，其中每个单位具有二元质量。卖方私下知道她的“类型”——由她拥有的次品数量定义——以及在她的禀赋中哪些单位是次品（“类型内逆向选择”）。我们刻画了信息约束下帕累托最优配置的集合，并表明每个这样的配置必须涉及以阈值 λ ∗ 为特征的贸易，其中拥有少于（多于）λ ∗ 个次品的类型仅出售其次品（出售其全部禀赋）。我们提供了分布变化的条件，这些条件给出帕累托改进的配置。（JEL D82, D86, L15）
